archive.headline: Europe’s AI transparency rules started August 2. Here’s when you should expect a label.
archive.summary: If you are in the EU, expect clearer disclosure in the covered situations: direct AI interaction, certain generated or manipulated media, deepfakes, emotion recognition, biometric categorisation and some public-interest text without human editorial control. If you publish or…

archive.headline: The label can tell you it was made with AI. It cannot tell you it is true.
archive.summary: Treat provenance as one receipt, not the whole investigation. If a label or content credential is present, use it to understand origin and editing history. Then separately check the claim against a named source, date and original context. If the label is missing, do not…
